```{r}
metdiffpath = "../results/metabolomics/DifferentialAnalysis/TtestMetabolomic.xlsx"

metAll = as.data.frame(mtbDt)

metAll$groupIGA = as.factor(smpDt$`GROUP IGA`)

cmps = c()
tpval = c()
nTot = c()
nNom = c()
meanNom = c()
stNom = c()
nDen = c()
meanDen = c()
stDen = c()
logFc = c()
nom = "1"
den = "2"
meTmp = metAll[metAll$groupIGA %in% c(nom, den),]
for (cmp in colnames(metAll)) {
  if (!cmp %in% "groupIGA") {
    
 test_result <- NULL
tryCatch({
  test_result <- t.test(meTmp[,cmp] ~ meTmp[,"groupIGA"], meTmp)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Error in processing column", cmp, ": ", e$message, "\n")
})
if (!is.null(test_result)) {
  tpval = append(tpval, test_result$p.value)
} else {
  tpval = append(tpval, NA)  # Se c'è un errore, metti NA
}
    
    cmps = append(cmps, cmp)
    #tpval = append(tpval, test_result$p.value)
    nTot = append(nTot, nrow(meTmp))
    nomTmp = meTmp[meTmp[,"groupIGA"] == nom,]
    nNom = append(nNom, nrow(nomTmp))
    meanNom = append(meanNom, mean(nomTmp[,cmp]))
    stNom = append(stNom, sd(nomTmp[,cmp]))
    
    
    denTmp = meTmp[meTmp[,"groupIGA"] == den,]
    nDen = append(nDen, nrow(denTmp))
    meanDen = append(meanDen, mean(denTmp[,cmp]))
    stDen = append(stDen, sd(denTmp[,cmp]))
    lfc = (mean(nomTmp[,cmp]) - mean(denTmp[,cmp]))
    logFc = append(logFc, lfc  )
    
  }

}
fdr = p.adjust((tpval), method = "fdr")
logFct = log2(abs(logFc))
logFc = (logFc)
res = NA
res = cbind(cmps,nTot, nNom,meanNom, stNom, nDen, meanDen, stDen,logFc, tpval, fdr)
res = as.data.frame(res)
colnames(res) = c("cmps", "n",paste0("n_",nom), paste0("mean_",nom), paste0("StDev_",nom), paste0("n_",den), paste0("mean_",den), paste0("StDev",den), "logFc", "p-value", "fdr")

res = res[(res$"p-value") != NaN,]
res = res[order(res$"p-value"),]
#xlsx::write.xlsx(res,metdiffpath, sheetName = var,  append = T)


res
View(res)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Assumiamo che res sia già un data.frame con colonne "cmps", "logFc", "fdr"
df <- res
df$logFc <- as.numeric(as.character(df$logFc))
df$fdr   <- as.numeric(as.character(df$fdr))

alpha <- 0.05
df$negLogFDR <- -log10(df$fdr)
df$Signif <- ifelse(df$fdr <= alpha, "Significant", "Not Significant")

# Volcano plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFc, y = negLogFDR, color = Signif)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Not Significant" = "grey70",
                                "Significant" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot - Metabolomics",
    x = paste0("log2 Fold Change (", nom, " vs ", den, ")"),
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  )

# Etichette su tutti i significativi
p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  data = subset(df, fdr <= alpha),
  aes(label = cmps),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = 50,
  box.padding = 0.4,
  show.legend = FALSE
)

print(p)

# Se vuoi salvare:
# ggsave("volcano_metabolomics.png", p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../results/metabolomics/volcano_Metabolites1vs2.png", p, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

Funzione rcorr con pvalue corretti
```{r}
library(Hmisc)

p_adjust_method = "fdr"

rcorr.adjust <- function (x, type = c("pearson", "spearman"), 
            use = c("complete.obs", "pairwise.complete.obs")) {
    opt <- options(scipen = 5)
    on.exit(options(opt))
    type <- match.arg(type)
    use <- match.arg(use)
    x <- if (use == "complete.obs") 
      as.matrix(na.omit(x))
    else as.matrix(x)
    R <- rcorr(x, type = type)
    P <- P.unadj <- R$P
    p <- P[lower.tri(P)]
    adj.p <- p.adjust(p, method = p_adjust_method)
    P[lower.tri(P)] <- adj.p
    P[upper.tri(P)] <- 0
    P <- P + t(P)
    P <- ifelse(P < 1e-04, 0, P)
    P <- format(round(P, 4))
    diag(P) <- ""
    P[c(grep("0.0000", P), grep("^ 0$", P))] <- "<.0001"
    P[grep("0.000$", P)] <- "<.001"
    P.unadj <- ifelse(P.unadj < 1e-04, 0, P.unadj)
    P.unadj <- format(round(P.unadj, 4))
    diag(P.unadj) <- ""
    P.unadj[c(grep("0.0000$", P.unadj), grep("^ 0$", P.unadj))] <- "<.0001"
    P.unadj[grep("0.000$", P.unadj)] <- "<.001"
    result <- list(R = R, P = P, P.unadj = P.unadj, type = type)
    class(result) <- "rcorr.adjust"
    result
  }

print.rcorr.adjust <- function(x, ...){
    cat("\n", if (x$type == "pearson") "Pearson" else "Spearman", "correlations:\n")
    print(round(x$R$r, 4))
    cat("\n Number of observations: ")
    n <- x$R$n
    if (all(n[1] == n)) cat(n[1], "\n")
    else{
        cat("\n")
        print(n)
    }
    cat("\n Pairwise two-sided p-values:\n")
    print(x$P.unadj, quote=FALSE)
    cat("\n Adjusted p-values (Holm's method)\n")
    print(x$P, quote=FALSE)
}
```

Cross-omics Heatmap
```{r}
logFC_df = py$logFcdf
pvalue_df = py$pvalsdf
Heatmp = ("../results/crossOmics/Pearson Cross-Omics Heatmap.png")

# Creare una matrice di annotazione con asterischi se p-value < 0.05
annotation_matrix <- ifelse(pvalue_df < 0.05, "*", "")

# Funzione per aggiungere asterischi alle celle della heatmap
heatmap_text <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  grid.text(annotation_matrix[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, col = "black"))
}

# Creare la heatmap con i valori di logFC
htmp = Heatmap(
  as.matrix(logFC_df),
  name = "logFC",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("red", "white", "blue")),
  cell_fun = heatmap_text,  # Aggiunge asterischi sulle celle
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = T,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))

png(Heatmp, width = 50/2.54, height = 40/2.54, res = 200, units = "in")
draw(htmp, heatmap_legend_side = "right", padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 8), "cm"))
dev.off()
```
